items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: That's where Ervin Le Claire and those guys were playing.

ctx.x: Oh! Down in the Vieux Carre?

Yes. It was the next block, was the Palace Theater. That's where Ervin Le Claire and those guys were playing. And the drummer, Stein. He was a sensational drummer too. They shined the light on him. And that's what they used to do me at the Lyric, shine the light on me.
